messages:
Anika: heads up — bringing up marlin-7b (mistral-style checkpoint) on llama runtime, seeing weird token-boundary artifacts in samples.
Matt: artifacts where exactly? paste an example.
Anika: short repro: prompt 'In 2040, cities will' -> output 'In 2040, cir/ty will' (slash shows mid-token split). more frequent with long prompts.
Sasha: that smells like tokenizer remap + rotary misalignment. did you run vocab remap with custom merges?
Anika: yes, remap-v2 with one manual merge for rare subtoken group. suspect that mapping collapsed a rare id into a common subtoken.
Jamie: also check the rotary table. marlin export used headwise freq scaling (freq_scale != 1). our llama runtime defaults to global freq table.
Matt: even a single index offset between our generated rotary angles and model kv-cache can make tokens break mid-generation.
Anika: quick tests: swapped to model-provided rotary table (marlin_rotary.npy) instead of generated, and forced tokenizer to use original eos index. ■ artifacts reduced but still present.
Sasha: dump the token ids pre/post remap for that prompt.
Anika: original ids: [320, 4096, 12, 98, 40599] 
Anika: remapped ids: [320, 4096, 12, 98, 1003]
Matt: bingo. 40599 -> 1003 means a rare token mapped to a frequent subtoken. that'll split the learned BPE/granularity.
Jamie: marlin used NFD normalization historically; our remapper applied NFKC by default. did you try switching normalizer?
Anika: yes — NFD matches training normalization and reduced splits significantly.
Sasha: so two compounding issues: (1) remap merged rare->common token, (2) rotary index/table mismatch. either alone noisy, together yields clear mid-token artifacts.
rotary-bot: queued job rotary-index-sanity-check #8799 :gear: (ETA ~10m)
ml-ci: added smoke test samples/long_prompt_vocab_probe.py to CI to reproduce locally.
Matt: plan: (1) revert that specific remap entry for 40599, (2) run grid on --rotary-headwise=true/false and --rotary-index-offset=0/1, (3) run long-context smoke + unit tests.
Anika: doing a small conversion patch now. conversion command used: 
```bash
convert-checkpoint --src-format=mistral --dst-format=llama --vocab-remap remap-v2.json \
  --rotary-table marlin_rotary.npy --preserve-eos
```
Matt: try toggling --rotary-headwise and also add a conversion lint to flag rare->common remaps.
Sasha: if problems persist, capture kv-cache dump (first 16 positions) for phase drift scan.
Anika: pushed PR with reverted remap and NFD tokenizer change: https://git.redwood/marlin-conversions/pull/42 — local runs show artifacts gone.
ml-ci: rotary-index-sanity-check #8799 completed: 1 failed (offset=1), 3 passed. failing grid = rotary-index-offset=1.
Anika: CI green on patched remap + NFD; artifacts gone in CI samples too.
Jamie: once merged, document recommended flags in onboarding checklist (eng-ml/onboarding/marlin) and add remap lint.
Matt: agreed. prevents future regressions when manual merges are used.
Sasha: thanks team, nice triage.
